content.text: » Sinus arrhythmia: irregularity rate of NSR (variation in P-P interval by ≥120ms)
➀ Respiratory (phasic): common, benign & usually normal; related mechanistically to alterations in autonomic input & d/t changes in cardiac filling during respiration
PATHO: inspiration reflexively inhibits vagal tone which increases heart rate, no inhibition w/ expiration ⇢ HR decreases
